newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt milling firm to pay out 4.10 pounds.
newsitem.headline: Egypt milling firm to pay out 4.10 pounds.

text.p: Central and West Delta Flour Mills will pay out an annual dividend of 4.10 pounds for the financial year 1995/6, up from 2.60 pounds in the previous year.
The dividend was approved at the company's general assembly on Monday, shareholders said on Tuesday.

Company executives told the meeting that in the first five months of 1996/7, the July-November period, the company made profits of 28 million pounds ($8.2 million), up from about 20 million in the same period of the previous year.
Earlier this month the company said its net after-tax profits rose to 43.121 million pounds ($12.68 million) in the financial year 1995/96 from 38.083 million in the previous year.
The financial year ends on June 30.
The shareholders' portion of distributable profits rose to 38.218 million, equivalent to about 5.10 pounds for each of the 7.5 million shares. This portion was 26.395 million in 1994/95.
Brokers said in September that Central and West Delta's unaudited net after-tax profits were 42.205 million pounds in the financial year 1995/96, against 38.07 million in 1994/5.
The shares closed unchanged on the Egyptian stock exchange on Monday at 81.50 pounds. By 1100 GMT on Tuesday they had last traded down at 78.61 pounds.
